fields.summary: On 2026-11-14 the conductor of run 01M7E56MGTY4M60XZNEG2A6537 planned change set 01M79KHH (Bring-your-own docs) with no owner present. Reading the code: conductor spawns (rhiza run spawn) start each child with 'follow rhiza guide <role>' and take no invoke; invokes exist on agent steps (ship-change's conduct step) and on leaves/checks role tables (ship-change-classic); rhiza skill check checks builder, verifier and check roles; rhiza init is non-interactive and there is no project agent setting, while run start, session start and skill check take --agent with the registered default adapter (claude-code, the only one); docs/reference/ holds only files rhiza docs generates. Three choices were put to the arbiter, who took the recommended option each time: the levels are skill (an installed skill plays one role), conductor (a team's own conduct skill on ship-change's conduct step, reading {brief}, {slice} and {handback}) and workflow (a team's own workflow from the primitives), each a worked example TOML under docs/examples/byo/ kept valid by a test; rhiza init asks with --agent or a terminal prompt over the registered adapters and stores the answer in a new project setting rhiza.project.agent that run start, session start and skill check use when --agent is unset; the primitives reference is a hand-written docs/primitives.md.
